questions.text: Describe a time when you received excellent service.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you received excellent service. You should say: where you were; what kind of service it was; what the person serving you did; and explain why you think the service was so good.

questions.text: Did you tell anyone about this experience afterwards?
questions.say: Thank you. Did you tell anyone about this experience afterwards?

Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you received excellent service, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all customer service. What makes good customer service?

questions.text: Is customer service better in small shops or in large companies?

questions.text: Will machines and chatbots replace people in customer service?

questions.say: Now let's talk about service jobs. What skills do people need to work in a restaurant or a shop?

questions.text: Why do many young people take service jobs while they are studying?
